key_insight: SVD-THC enables a single multiplexed block encoding of molecular Hamiltonian ensembles whose Toffoli cost grows only weakly with ensemble size.
engineering_relevance: The approach could reduce fault-tolerant quantum computing costs for coherently exploring molecular conformations and reactivity.
method: Extend tensor hypercontraction across molecular geometries using an ensemble singular value decomposition.
Construct one multiplexed Hamiltonian block encoding for all geometries.
Evaluate resource costs for block encoding and energy thresholding.
evidence_signal: Across ensembles of up to 5,184 geometries for three molecular systems, block-encoding Toffoli costs changed by at most 12% over grids differing by up to 576×, while energy thresholding used 35–200× fewer Toffoli gates than combining single-geometry block encodings.
watch_item: The reported resource savings cover selected molecular ensembles; broader scalability and practical fault-tolerant implementation remain to be established.
paper_title: Efficient Block Encodings for Ensembles of Molecular Hamiltonians
